title: Angry Emoji: Copy & Paste 😡 Mad Faces, Emoticons & Combos
meta_description: Angry emoji 😡 🤬 😤, classic angry emoticons like >:( and rage combo sets for venting in chats and comments. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: Red-faced rage, steam, fire and typed-out >:( emoticons: anger in every intensity. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The angry emoji scale runs from a mild 😠 scowl to the censor-grawlix fury of 🤬, and when an app shows emoji as boxes, a typed >:( still gets the point across. This page gathers every mad face, the fire-and-explosion symbols that turn a complaint into a rage post, eye-rolling annoyed faces for lower-grade irritation, and one-click angry combo sets for chats, comments, and gaming rage moments.
